title: Spectacular
text: Spectacular excursion, we spent a great day with the family, we saw a lot of dolphins and it was super exciting. A thousand thanks to the guy who was super attentive, it couldn't be better than 10.

title: 100% recommendable
text:
100% recommended experience, enjoying those landscapes, that sea with that color and feeling what sailing is like has been a dream come true. Thank you Alberto for the hospitality and the sailboat is wonderful and super comfortable.
We will be back!

title: Wonderful sunset sailing with friends
text:

Thank you!!
